summary: Checkpoint recovery may retry only a strictly newer advertised checkpoint.

repeat_same_checkpoint.defect: An unchanged listing can cause a retry without progress.

repeat_same_checkpoint_with_weakened_con.defect: Both the decision and its contract allow an unchanged listing to cause a retry.

mutate.find:
(i64::MAX as int) - (out.unwrap() as int)
            < (i64::MAX as int) - (attempted as int)
mutate.replace:
(i64::MAX as int) - (out.unwrap() as int)
            <= (i64::MAX as int) - (attempted as int)

refuse_newer_checkpoint.defect: A newer advertised checkpoint can never be tried.

refuse_newer_checkpoint_with_weakened_co.defect: The Rust function and its contract agree to refuse every listing.
